cells.gaps: The pilot of individual student tracking is named with no system, level, school count or method of entry; nothing says it is past its pilot. Governance is not held inside the 36 months: the ministry's ownership is dated May 2019 and the plan naming SEGI ran 2020-2025, ended before the as-at. MOZ-001 and MOZ-002 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: A pilot of individual student tracking, level not named and so read as primary, is stage 2. Stage 3 needs live use past a pilot in some primary schools, and no row shows it.
